ingress_capacity.rationale: PROPOSED combined callback mailbox bound; at most 256 MiB decoded pixels at the configured per-image cap, plus bounded core buffers. Pi memory/backlog still needs measurement.

image_capacity.rationale: PROPOSED per-side unmatched image bound, consistent with vio_adapter development default.

imu_capacity.rationale: PROPOSED combined camera IMU sample bound, consistent with vio_adapter development default.

event_capacity.rationale: PROPOSED retained runtime event window; overwrite loss is reported.

max_imu_gap_ns.rationale: PROPOSED development guard from tools/vio_adapter; not a qualified sensor limit.

max_image_bytes.rationale: PROPOSED 1 MiB MONO8 payload cap, enough for 1280x800 IR; bounds callback copy/memory and rejects unexpected profiles.

max_ros_step_ns.rationale: PROPOSED ordinary replay clock increment guard for clock_policy.hpp; restart after seek.

worker_poll_ms.rationale: PROPOSED idle worker poll period; no measured scheduling guarantee.

qos_depth.rationale: PROPOSED DDS sensor-data keep-last bound; DDS loss is separate from application counters.
